result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by residential row houses with sidewalks that are frequently obstructed by parked vehicles. While a marked crosswalk exists, it is severely faded, and the lack of curb ramps and clear sightlines at the corner creates significant safety risks.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Parking
hazards.description: Vehicles are parked on the paved area intended for pedestrians, forcing people to walk in the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image in front of the row houses

hazards.name: Corner Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: A large pickup truck is parked immediately adjacent to the crosswalk, blocking the view between pedestrians and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image at the intersection corner

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra-style markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces within 20-30 feet of the crosswalk to improve sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk with high-visibility thermoplastic markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) to shorten the crossing distance and physically prevent illegal parking at the corner.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a wide, unmarked intersection with incomplete sidewalk infrastructure. Pedestrians lack designated crossing points and are exposed to traffic on a roadway without lane markings or traffic control devices.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at this wide intersection, leaving pedestrians without a designated or protected path.

hazards.name: Incomplete Sidewalk Network
hazards.description: The left side of the street lacks a clear, paved sidewalk, potentially forcing pedestrians into the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image along the open lot

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to define pedestrian space and alert drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add bulb-outs at the corners to shorten crossing distances and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Completion
interventions.description: Construct a continuous paved sidewalk on the left side of the street to provide a safe walking path.

result.summary: The intersection lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks, curb ramps, or signals. The wide roadway and presence of visual obstructions from mature trees and parked vehicles create a high-exposure environment for pedestrians in a residential setting.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks at this wide intersection, leaving pedestrians without a designated or protected path.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Large trees and parked vehicles near the intersection corners may block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and right corners of the intersection

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility continental crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian space and alert drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions (bulb-outs) to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility of pedestrians waiting to cross.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install detectable warning surfaces and sloped ramps to ensure accessibility for all users at the crossing points.

result.summary: The image depicts a residential intersection with sidewalks but a complete lack of dedicated pedestrian crossing infrastructure. The absence of marked crosswalks, curb ramps, and traffic calming measures, combined with sightline obstructions from parked cars, creates a high-risk environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crosswalk
hazards.description: The intersection lacks any painted markings to designate pedestrian crossing areas, increasing the risk of vehicle-pedestrian conflict.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection corners block the view between pedestrians waiting to cross and approaching drivers.

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Ramps
hazards.description: The absence of ADA-compliant curb ramps creates a significant barrier for individuals with mobility aids or strollers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style pavement markings to clearly define pedestrian space and alert drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install sloped curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces at all four corners of the intersection.
